TMDX TransMedics Group guidance raise OR cut 2026

findings.claim: Q2 2026（8/4 公布）營收 $189.9M 年增 20.7%，高於共識 3.1%；調整後 EPS $0.44 低於 Zacks 共識 $0.50；FY2026 營收指引低標上調至 $737–757M（前為 $727–757M）。
findings.source: Zacks/Chartmill, TransMedics (TMDX) Q2 Earnings Lag Estimates; BioSpace, TransMedics Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results

findings.claim: MarketBeat：2026-06-02 共識評級 Hold，13 家券商平均目標價 $134.00（7 Hold／6 Buy）；5 月 MarketBeat 約 $135。其他聚合站（無明確日期）區間 $113–$128.92，低 $70–$85、高 $142–$178。
findings.source: MarketBeat, TransMedics Group given average rating of Hold by brokerages (2026-06-02); StockAnalysis; Benzinga

findings.claim: Q2 財報後 Piper Sandler 維持 Overweight 但目標價由 $120 降至 $100；MarketBeat 8/5 標題為財報後股價跳空下跌；MarketBeat 後續共識目標價 $124.45（日期不一）。
findings.source: MarketBeat, TransMedics earns overweight rating from Piper Sandler (2026-08-05)

findings.claim: 搜尋摘要指 2026-11-05 公司將 FY2026 營收指引上調至 $750–760M（不含 PAD Aviation；含則 $764–774M），前為 $737–757M；Zacks 稱同時下調調整後利潤率展望至 12.5%–14%（未獲一手來源確認）。8-K 內文未讀。
findings.source: SEC 8-K Ex.99.1 (TransMedics Q3 2026 results) via search summary; Webull

findings.claim: Q2 前 Zacks 預估修正趨勢不利，Zacks Rank #5（Strong Sell）；Zacks 共識 FY 營收 $733.24M／EPS $1.82，低於當時指引中點約 2%。Benzinga 顯示放空比例約 38.6% 流通股。
findings.source: Zacks via Nasdaq, Why Is TransMedics (TMDX) Up 10.2% Since Last Earnings Report?; Benzinga
